texts.value: Catalyzes the reversible conversion of succinyl-CoA to (R)-methylmalonyl-CoA through a radical mechanism (PubMed:9772164). Is involved in the fermentation of pyruvate to propanoate that occurs in Propionibacteria (Probable)
kcat is 48 sec(-1) with succinyl-CoA as substrate.
Heterodimer of an alpha and a beta chain
Belongs to the methylmalonyl-CoA mutase family

features.description: Does not significantly affect affinity for succiny-CoA, but kcat is lowered about 580-fold.
